paper.title: Low-fatigue, adjustable pressure garments at 10, 20 and 30 mm Hg reduce scar thickness and improve pliability

open_dataset.janus_value: permits non-heuristic re-analysis of pressure dose, garment fatigue, scar trajectory and terminal biomechanical endpoints

experimental_root.pressure_start: 7 days post-grafting immediately after dressing removal
experimental_root.pressure_control: garments adjusted daily to restore target interface pressure
experimental_root.terminal_biomechanics: week 12 BTC-2000 scar stiffness, elasticity and laxity

mechanical_exit_coupling_audit.M1_reason: Pressure begins at week 1, when histology reports minimal ECM deposition and a large dermal cell population; the required established scar/activated-repair state is not demonstrated before intervention.
mechanical_exit_coupling_audit.M3_reason: Interface pressure is longitudinally quantified, but scar-tissue biomechanical state is reported terminally at week 12 rather than as a qualifying pre-intervention plus post-intervention tissue-mechanics trajectory.
mechanical_exit_coupling_audit.M4_reason: The root does not measure lineage/state-resolved myofibroblast abundance, alpha-SMA with state identity, apoptosis, clearance or validated activated-cell shutdown.

dose_response_falsification_control.finding: All 10, 20 and 30 mmHg groups significantly improved terminal scar stiffness, elasticity and laxity versus controls, while the pressure-treated groups were statistically equivalent for those biomechanical endpoints; 30 mmHg showed stronger contraction prevention than 10 or 20 mmHg.
dose_response_falsification_control.consequence: Do not assume a monotonic scalar rule in which higher pressure necessarily produces proportionally better mechanical scar normalization across endpoints.

frozen_boundaries: Open raw/analysis data do not upgrade a causal gate when required biological measurements are absent.
Garment-skin interface pressure is not identical to scar tissue modulus.
The authors discuss prior myofibroblast-apoptosis literature, but those external observations are not measurements in this causal root and are not fused into M4.
A week-1 intervention in a developing graft scar is not reclassified as delayed treatment of an established scar.
No pressure threshold is inferred from group-level outcome equivalence.

next_exact_analysis.dataset_task: download and hash the Dryad dataset, identify the exact pressure/time/biomechanics tables, and test prespecified monotonic versus plateau dose-response models without selecting a preferred model from the observed result
next_exact_analysis.coupling_task: do not reopen M4 unless this same cohort contains an unindexed state-resolved myofibroblast/apoptosis dataset
